items.name: Policy change log
items.note: Prior review listed; current signed approval absent [S2]

after.title: Key judgment — core calculation rules exist
after.text: The manual states four core areas: TWR, accrual, fee and theoretical-performance rules [S1]. Their presence establishes a calculation foundation, but the review still depends on whether each rule is current, operationally assigned and consistently supported by retained records.

after.title: Key judgment — current governance is unproven
after.text: The change log contains no approval record for the current manual [S2]. Without a dated approval, the review cannot determine whether governance accepted this revision, so a signed record remains necessary to establish currency and accountable authorization.

after.title: Key judgment — operational ownership is thin
after.text: Valuation, report sign-off and portability controls omit accountable owners [S1]. The missing assignments materially weaken execution because the manual does not identify who performs, reviews or approves these three recurring control responsibilities when exceptions arise.

after.title: Key judgment — three policy areas are absent
after.text: Three policy areas were not located: significant cash flows, distribution tracking and record retention [S1]. Their absence leaves portfolio treatment, recipient evidence and retention duties undefined, requiring separate approved policies or explicit additions to the manual.

items.title: Current approval not evidenced
items.detail: The change log has no signed approval for the current manual [S2].

items.title: Error threshold absent
items.detail: The error policy omits materiality thresholds [S1].

items.title: Reporting owners absent
items.detail: Valuation estimates and report sign-off lack accountable owners [S1].

items.title: Benchmark-change timing undefined
items.detail: The benchmark policy does not define approval timing [S1].

items.title: Portability ownership absent
items.detail: The portability policy does not identify its documentation owner [S1].

items.title: Cash-flow policy not found
items.detail: No ex ante significant-cash-flow policy was located [S1].

items.title: Distribution tracking not found
items.detail: No reasonable-efforts tracking policy was located [S1].

items.title: Retention schedule not found
items.detail: No supporting-record retention schedule was located [S1].

after.title: Analysis — governance currency is unproven
after.text: **Observation:** No current approval date is evidenced for this revision [S2]. **Why it matters:** Governance cannot be tied to the reviewed manual version. **Uncertainty:** A signed approval record may exist outside supplied coverage. **What would change the view:** Follow-up request 1 producing dated approval evidence.

after.title: Analysis — control specificity is uneven
after.text: **Observation:** Six areas lack owners, timing or thresholds [S1]. **Why it matters:** Execution is not reproducible from policy. **Uncertainty:** Procedures may sit outside the manual. **What would change the view:** Follow-up request 2 and follow-up request 3.

after.title: Analysis — evidence retention is incomplete
after.text: **Observation:** Three required policy areas were not found [S1]. **Why it matters:** Compliance evidence may not be retained or distributed consistently. **Uncertainty:** Separate approved policies were not supplied for review. **What would change the view:** Follow-up request 4 producing all three policy records.

Add owners and timing for valuation estimates, benchmark changes and report sign-off.
Provide significant-cash-flow, distribution-tracking and record-retention policies.
